source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2010 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 2010 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. County cells and statewide totals transcribed from page 1 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State; every candidate's 15 county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL. Cells were read from the document's text layer and checked against the page images. Named write-ins are included. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer from the Secretary of State and is retained under data/raw/us-senate/pdfs with its SHA-256 recorded in the snapshots. Event turnout is shared with the Governor and Attorney General contests of the same election.

additional_sources.title: OpenElections Arizona — U.S. Senate county results, 2000–2012 (comparison)
additional_sources.notes: Independent open-data county results compiled from the official canvass; used only to cross-check the transcribed cells. See data/processed/us-senate/validation/openelections-comparison.json.
